requirements.text: Sistem, vatandaşların e-Devlet Kapısı kimlik doğrulaması ile oturum açmasını sağlayacaktır.
Sistem, 15 dakika boyunca işlem yapılmayan oturumu sonlandıracak ve kullanıcıyı oturum açma sayfasına yönlendirecektir.
requirements.note: Sınır değer: eşiğin hemen altı ve hemen üstü denenmeli.

requirements.text: Sistem, kurum personelinin yönetim paneline kullanıcı adı ve parola ile girişinde, art arda 5 başarısız denemeden sonra hesabı 30 dakika süreyle kilitleyecektir.
requirements.note: İki sınır var: deneme sayısı ve kilit süresi. Araya giren başarılı giriş sayacı sıfırlar.

requirements.text: Kullanıcı, başvuru formuna her biri en fazla 10 MB olan PDF, JPEG veya PNG biçiminde en çok 5 ek dosya yükleyebilecektir.
requirements.note: Üç ayrı kısıt: boyut, biçim, adet.

requirements.text: Sistem, tamamlanan her başvuru için benzersiz bir takip numarası üretecek ve bu numarayı kullanıcıya e-posta ile bildirecektir.
requirements.note: Bileşik gereksinim: üretim ve bildirim ayrı ayrı doğrulanmalı.

requirements.text: Sistem, yarım bırakılan başvuruyu taslak olarak saklayacak ve kullanıcının 30 gün içinde kaldığı yerden devam etmesine izin verecektir.
requirements.note: 30 günlük sınır sistem saati ilerletilerek denenir.

requirements.text: Kullanıcı arayüzü, WCAG 2.1 AA düzeyi erişilebilirlik ölçütlerini karşılayacaktır.
requirements.method_rationale: Ölçütlerin bir kısmı araçla ve kullanımla test edilir, kalanı uzman incelemesi gerektirir.
requirements.note: Çoklu yöntem. Yalnızca otomatik tarama yeterli sayılmamalı.

requirements.text: Kişisel veriler, kurumun veri yerleşimi politikası gereği yalnızca Türkiye sınırları içindeki sunucularda saklanacaktır.
requirements.method_rationale: Dağıtım mimarisi, barındırma sözleşmesi ve yapılandırma belgeleri incelenerek doğrulanır.
requirements.note: Tuzak: test durumu beklenmez. Model test uydurursa hata sayılır.

requirements.text: The service shall classify each submitted document into exactly one of the 12 defined categories and shall return a confidence score between 0 and 1.
The classification model shall achieve a macro-averaged F1 score of at least 0.90 on the held-out evaluation set.
requirements.method_rationale: Measured by running the model on a labelled set.
requirements.note: The evaluation set must not overlap the training data.

requirements.text: Documents whose confidence score is below 0.60 shall be routed to a human review queue instead of being classified automatically.
requirements.method_rationale: Routing is observable; threshold is exact.
requirements.note: Boundary: 0.60 itself is not below the threshold.

requirements.text: The service shall return a classification result within 500 ms for the 95th percentile of requests at a load of 50 requests per second.
requirements.note: Percentile and load must both appear in the test.

requirements.text: The service shall record the model version, the input hash and the predicted category for every request.
requirements.method_rationale: Records can be queried and compared.

requirements.text: The service shall raise an alert when the weekly distribution of predicted categories deviates from the baseline with a population stability index greater than 0.2.
requirements.note: Needs data on both sides of the threshold.

requirements.text: For each classification, the service shall provide the three text passages that contributed most to the decision.
requirements.method_rationale: Presence and provenance of passages are testable; whether they contributed most needs analysis of the attribution method.
requirements.note: Tuzak: 'contributed most' is not defined. A good answer flags the ambiguity.

requirements.text: The model shall not show a difference greater than 5 percentage points in recall between documents written in Turkish and documents written in English.
requirements.method_rationale: Computed from evaluation results split by language; subset sizes need statistical judgement.
requirements.note: Çoklu yöntem.

test_cases.preconditions: The model is stubbed to return a set score, or documents with known scores are available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Three documents with confidence scores of 0.59, 0.60 and 0.61.

steps.action: Submit the document that scores 0.59.
steps.expected: The document appears in the human review queue and is not classified automatically.

steps.action: Submit the document that scores 0.60.
steps.expected: The document is classified automatically and does not appear in the queue.

steps.action: Submit the document that scores 0.61.
steps.expected: The document is classified automatically and does not appear in the queue.

test_cases.title: Response time at 50 requests per second
test_cases.preconditions: A production-equivalent environment and a load generator are available.
test_cases.test_inputs: 50 requests per second for 15 minutes, with representative document sizes.
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement gives no measurement duration; 15 minutes is assumed.

steps.action: Apply the load and record the response time of every request.
steps.expected: No request fails because of the load.

steps.action: Compute the 95th percentile of the response times.
steps.expected: The 95th percentile is at most 500 ms.

test_cases.title: Request record content
test_cases.preconditions: Access to the request records is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Three documents, two of them identical.

steps.action: Submit the three documents.
steps.expected: Each request is answered with a category.

steps.action: Query the request records.
steps.expected: There are three records, each holding the model version, the input hash and the predicted category; the two identical documents have the same hash.

steps.action: Deploy a new model version and submit one more document.
steps.expected: The new record shows the new model version.

test_cases.title: Drift alert around the PSI threshold
test_cases.preconditions: A baseline category distribution is recorded and a week of synthetic requests can be replayed.
test_cases.test_inputs: A week of requests that gives a PSI of about 0.15; a week that gives a PSI of about 0.25.

steps.action: Replay the week that gives a PSI of about 0.15.
steps.expected: No alert is raised.

steps.action: Replay the week that gives a PSI of about 0.25.
steps.expected: An alert is raised and it states the measured PSI.

test_cases.title: Three supporting passages per classification
test_cases.preconditions: The service is deployed.
test_cases.test_inputs: A document of several paragraphs; a document that holds fewer than three passages.
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement does not define how contribution is measured; this test checks presence and provenance only.

steps.action: Submit the document of several paragraphs.
steps.expected: The response lists three passages.

steps.action: Compare the three passages with the document.
steps.expected: Each passage is found verbatim in the document.

steps.action: Submit the short document.
steps.expected: The request is answered without error and lists the passages that exist.

test_cases.title: Recall gap between Turkish and English
test_cases.preconditions: The evaluation set carries a language label and both languages have a comparable category mix.
test_cases.test_inputs: The Turkish and the English subsets of the evaluation set.

steps.action: Compute recall on each subset.
steps.expected: Recall is reported for each subset together with the subset size.

steps.action: Compute the absolute difference between the two values.
steps.expected: The difference is at most 5 percentage points.

test_cases.title: Low-confidence requests are recorded too
test_cases.preconditions: Access to the request records is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: A document that scores below 0.60.

steps.action: Submit the document.
steps.expected: The document is routed to the human review queue.

steps.action: Query the request records.
steps.expected: A record with the model version, the input hash and the predicted category exists for the request.

requirements.text: The application shall allow a medic to create a casualty record containing an identifier, a triage category, an injury description and the time of injury.
The application shall support the four triage categories Immediate, Delayed, Minimal and Expectant, and shall display each with a distinct colour.
The application shall record vital signs (heart rate, respiratory rate, blood pressure and SpO2) with a timestamp and shall reject values outside the plausible ranges defined in the configuration.
requirements.note: Boundary and invalid-input cases for each vital sign.

requirements.text: The application shall remain fully functional without network connectivity and shall store at least 500 casualty records locally.
requirements.note: Bileşik: offline function and capacity.

requirements.text: When connectivity is restored, the application shall synchronise local records with the server and shall resolve conflicting edits by keeping both versions for manual review.
requirements.method_rationale: Exercised with two devices editing the same record.
requirements.note: Conflict case needs two devices.

requirements.text: All casualty data stored on the device shall be encrypted with AES-256.
requirements.method_rationale: Algorithm and key length are confirmed by design and configuration inspection; unreadability of storage is tested.
requirements.note: Çoklu yöntem. A test alone cannot prove the algorithm.

requirements.text: The application shall be operable by a user wearing surgical gloves.
requirements.method_rationale: Shown by a user performing the main tasks with gloves on.
requirements.note: Tuzak: test durumu beklenmez. 'Operable' has no measurable criterion; a good answer says so.

requirements.text: The tablet running the application shall operate for at least 8 hours on a single battery charge under the defined usage profile.
requirements.method_rationale: Endurance run with the usage profile.

test_cases.title: Create a casualty record
test_cases.preconditions: A medic is signed in to the application.
test_cases.test_inputs: Identifier C-014; triage category Delayed; injury description 'left forearm fracture'; time of injury 10:42.

steps.action: Open a new casualty record.
steps.expected: An empty record form is shown.

steps.action: Enter the four values and save.
steps.expected: The record is saved without error.

steps.action: Reopen the record.
steps.expected: The four fields show the entered values.

test_cases.title: Four triage categories with distinct colours
test_cases.preconditions: A medic is signed in to the application.

steps.action: Open the triage category selector.
steps.expected: Exactly the categories Immediate, Delayed, Minimal and Expectant are offered.

steps.action: Create four records, one in each category.
steps.expected: The four records are saved.

steps.action: View the casualty list.
steps.expected: Each category is displayed in a colour that differs from the other three.

test_cases.title: Record vital signs with a timestamp
test_cases.preconditions: A casualty record exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Two sets of vital signs within the configured ranges.

steps.action: Enter the first set and save.
steps.expected: The set is stored with the time of entry.

steps.action: Five minutes later enter the second set and save.
steps.expected: The second set is stored with its own timestamp and both sets are listed in time order.

test_cases.title: Vital signs at and beyond the configured limits
test_cases.preconditions: A casualty record exists; the configured minimum and maximum of each vital sign are known.
test_cases.test_inputs: For each vital sign: the configured minimum and maximum, a value one unit below the minimum, a value one unit above the maximum, and the text 'abc'.

steps.action: For each vital sign enter the minimum, then the maximum.
steps.expected: The values are accepted and stored.

steps.action: For each vital sign enter the value below the minimum.
steps.expected: The value is rejected with a message that names the field and nothing is stored.

steps.action: For each vital sign enter the value above the maximum.
steps.expected: The value is rejected with a message that names the field and nothing is stored.

steps.action: Enter 'abc' in each field.
steps.expected: The value is rejected and nothing is stored.

test_cases.title: Full function without connectivity
test_cases.preconditions: The application is installed and a medic is signed in.

steps.action: Disable all network connectivity on the tablet.
steps.expected: The application stays open and usable.

steps.action: Create a casualty record and record vital signs.
steps.expected: Both are saved without a network error.

steps.action: Change the triage category and reopen the record.
steps.expected: The record shows the new category.

test_cases.title: 500 records stored locally
test_cases.preconditions: Network connectivity is disabled; a script that creates casualty records is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: 500 generated casualty records.

steps.action: Create the 500 records.
steps.expected: All records are created without error.

steps.action: Restart the application.
steps.expected: All 500 records are listed.

steps.action: Open the first, the 250th and the 500th record.
steps.expected: Each opened record is complete.

test_cases.title: Synchronisation after connectivity returns
test_cases.preconditions: The tablet has synchronised at least one record with the server.
test_cases.test_inputs: Two new records and one edit to an existing record.

steps.action: Disable connectivity; create the two records and make the edit.
steps.expected: The changes are saved locally.

steps.action: Restore connectivity.
steps.expected: The tablet shows the records as synchronised.

steps.action: Inspect the records on the server.
steps.expected: The server holds the two new records and the edit.

test_cases.title: Conflicting edits are both kept
test_cases.preconditions: Tablets A and B hold the same synchronised casualty record.
test_cases.test_inputs: Triage category Immediate on A; triage category Delayed on B.

steps.action: Disable connectivity on both tablets.
steps.expected: Both tablets still show the record.

steps.action: Set the triage category on A and on B.
steps.expected: Each tablet saves its own edit locally.

steps.action: Restore connectivity on A, then on B.
steps.expected: Neither edit is discarded; both versions are kept and the record is marked for manual review.

test_cases.title: Stored casualty data is not readable in clear text
test_cases.preconditions: A test tablet whose storage can be extracted is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: The marker string TRIAGE-MARKER-7731.
test_cases.assumptions: This test shows that data is not stored in clear text; the algorithm and key length are confirmed by inspection.

steps.action: Create casualty records that contain the marker string.
steps.expected: The records are saved.

steps.action: Extract the application's storage files from the tablet.
steps.expected: The files are obtained.

steps.action: Search the files for the marker string and try to open them as a plain database.
steps.expected: The marker string is not found and the files cannot be opened as a plain database.

test_cases.title: Eight hours on one battery charge
test_cases.preconditions: The battery is fully charged; a script that runs the usage profile is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: The defined usage profile.

steps.action: Start the usage profile from a full charge.
steps.expected: The profile runs on the tablet.

steps.action: Record the time until the tablet shuts down or reports a critical battery level.
steps.expected: The recorded time is at least 8 hours.

requirements.text: Ağ geçidi, geçerli bir OAuth 2.0 erişim belirteci taşımayan istekleri HTTP 401 yanıtıyla reddedecektir.
requirements.note: Geçersizliğin birden çok türü var: yok, süresi dolmuş, bozuk.

requirements.text: The gateway shall enforce role-based access so that a client may call only the endpoints assigned to its role, and shall return HTTP 403 otherwise.
Ağ geçidi, istemci başına dakikada 600 istek sınırını uygulayacak ve sınırı aşan istekleri HTTP 429 yanıtı ve Retry-After başlığı ile yanıtlayacaktır.
requirements.note: Sınır istemci başınadır; ikinci istemci etkilenmemeli.

requirements.text: The gateway shall add no more than 20 ms of latency at the 99th percentile under a load of 2,000 requests per second.
requirements.note: Added latency needs a baseline measurement.

requirements.text: Arka uç servisi 5 saniye içinde yanıt vermezse ağ geçidi isteği sonlandıracak ve HTTP 504 dönecektir.
requirements.note: Sınır değer.

requirements.text: Configuration changes shall take effect without restarting the gateway and without dropping in-flight requests.
requirements.method_rationale: Exercised under load with long-running requests.
requirements.note: Bileşik: no restart and no dropped requests.

requirements.text: Ağ geçidi, her istek için izleme kimliği, istemci kimliği, uç nokta, yanıt kodu ve süre bilgisini yapılandırılmış günlük olarak kaydedecektir.
requirements.note: Reddedilen istekler de 'her istek' kapsamındadır.

requirements.text: The platform shall provide a monthly availability of at least 99.95%, excluding planned maintenance windows.
requirements.method_rationale: Shown by availability modelling and operational records; it cannot be established by a single test run.
requirements.note: Tuzak: test durumu beklenmez.

test_cases.title: Belirteçsiz ve geçersiz belirteçli istekler
test_cases.preconditions: Ağ geçidinin arkasında istekleri sayan bir test servisi çalışmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Authorization başlığı olmayan bir istek; süresi dolmuş bir belirteç; imzası bozulmuş bir belirteç.

steps.action: Authorization başlığı olmadan istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: HTTP 401 döner ve istek arka uç servisine ulaşmaz.

steps.action: Süresi dolmuş belirteçle istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: HTTP 401 döner ve istek arka uç servisine ulaşmaz.

steps.action: İmzası bozulmuş belirteçle istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: HTTP 401 döner ve istek arka uç servisine ulaşmaz.

test_cases.title: Geçerli belirteçle istek
test_cases.preconditions: Ağ geçidinin arkasında bir test servisi çalışmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Geçerli bir OAuth 2.0 erişim belirteci.

steps.action: Geçerli belirteçle istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: İstek arka uç servisine iletilir ve servisin yanıtı döner.

test_cases.title: Role-based access to endpoints
test_cases.preconditions: The role 'reader' is assigned GET /orders only.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid token that carries the role 'reader'.

steps.action: Call GET /orders.
steps.expected: The call is forwarded to the backend and succeeds.

steps.action: Call POST /orders.
steps.expected: HTTP 403 is returned and the call is not forwarded.

steps.action: Call GET /admin/users.
steps.expected: HTTP 403 is returned and the call is not forwarded.

test_cases.title: İstemci başına hız sınırı
test_cases.preconditions: İki ayrı istemci kimliği tanımlıdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Birinci istemciden 601 istek; ikinci istemciden 1 istek.
test_cases.assumptions: Dakika sabit pencere olarak sayılır; kayan pencere uygulanıyorsa son adımdaki bekleme Retry-After değerine göre yapılır.

steps.action: Birinci istemciden bir dakika içinde 600 istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: İsteklerin tümü kabul edilir.

steps.action: Aynı dakika içinde 601. istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: HTTP 429 ve Retry-After başlığı döner.

steps.action: Aynı dakika içinde ikinci istemciden bir istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: İstek kabul edilir.

steps.action: Retry-After süresi kadar beklenir ve birinci istemciden yeni bir istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: İstek kabul edilir.

test_cases.title: Added latency at 2,000 requests per second
test_cases.preconditions: A backend stub with a fixed response time and a load generator are available.
test_cases.test_inputs: 2,000 requests per second for 15 minutes.
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement gives no measurement duration; 15 minutes is assumed.

steps.action: Measure the 99th-percentile response time when calling the stub directly.
steps.expected: The baseline value is recorded.

steps.action: Measure the 99th-percentile response time through the gateway at the same load.
steps.expected: The value exceeds the baseline by at most 20 ms.

test_cases.title: Arka uç zaman aşımı
test_cases.preconditions: Yanıt süresi ayarlanabilen bir arka uç test servisi çalışmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Arka uç yanıt süreleri: 4,8 saniye ve 6 saniye.

steps.action: Arka uç 4,8 saniyede yanıt verecek şekilde ayarlanır ve bir istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: Arka ucun yanıtı döner.

steps.action: Arka uç 6 saniyede yanıt verecek şekilde ayarlanır ve bir istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: İstek yaklaşık 5. saniyede sonlandırılır ve HTTP 504 döner.

test_cases.title: Configuration change under load
test_cases.preconditions: A steady load of 500 requests per second is applied, including requests that take 10 seconds each.
test_cases.test_inputs: A configuration change that adds a new route.

steps.action: Record the gateway process identifier.
steps.expected: The identifier is recorded.

steps.action: Add the new route to the configuration and apply it.
steps.expected: The change is applied and the process identifier is unchanged.

steps.action: Call the new route.
steps.expected: The new route answers.

steps.action: Check the requests that were in flight during the change.
steps.expected: No request failed or was reset.

test_cases.title: İstek başına yapılandırılmış günlük kaydı
test_cases.preconditions: Günlük kayıtlarına erişim vardır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bilinen bir istemci kimliğiyle başarılı bir istek ve HTTP 404 dönen bir istek.

steps.action: İki istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: Biri başarılı yanıt, diğeri HTTP 404 alır.

steps.action: Günlük kayıtları okunur.
steps.expected: Her istek için izleme kimliği, istemci kimliği, uç nokta, yanıt kodu ve süre alanlarını içeren, makinece ayrıştırılabilir bir kayıt vardır; değerler gönderilen isteklerle tutarlıdır.

test_cases.title: Reddedilen istekler de günlüğe yazılır
test_cases.preconditions: Günlük kayıtlarına erişim vardır; hız sınırı etkindir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Hız sınırını aşan bir istek.

steps.action: Hız sınırı aşılacak şekilde istek gönderilir.
steps.expected: HTTP 429 döner.

steps.action: Günlük kayıtları okunur.
steps.expected: Yanıt kodu 429 olan bir günlük kaydı vardır.
